hyperedges.label: Receiver-typed cross-file member-call resolvers sharing the god-node guard
indirect_call capture across argument, dispatch-table, assignment/return, getattr and JS/TS forms
Full-path node-ID identity change and the components that had to migrate with it

nodes.label: Breaking: full repo-relative path node IDs
nodes.rationale: The old parent-dir+filename stem made same-named files in different directories collide into one last-writer-wins node, silently dropping graph content; the full repo-relative stem keeps them distinct and aligns the AST extractor, LLM system prompt, and stem helpers on one rule.

nodes.label: Single-definition god-node guard
nodes.rationale: Deliberate precision-over-recall: an ambiguous or uninferable receiver resolves to nothing rather than a wrong edge, because name-only matching fabricates phantom edges and false god nodes.

nodes.label: Cross-language edge guard
nodes.rationale: Edges binding across interop families weld a polyglot repo's halves together at a phantom edge, inflating betweenness and manufacturing a #1 god node.

nodes.label: indirect_call relation
nodes.rationale: Kept as a distinct INFERRED relation separate from calls so strict call-graph queries stay precise, while affected (blast radius) still reaches indirectly dispatched handlers.

nodes.label: extract.py module
nodes.rationale: Decomposed from 17,054 to 4,740 LOC as verbatim moves only, with every original import path preserved via re-exports and no behavior change.

nodes.label: _SHEBANG_DISPATCH
nodes.rationale: Only interpreters with a real extractor are mapped, so unsupported interpreters stay skipped rather than mis-parsed by a wrong grammar.

nodes.label: _is_sensitive()
nodes.rationale: A genuine programming-language source file is exempted from the weak name-keyword heuristic, while real secret stores in data/config formats are still caught.

nodes.label: build_from_json()
nodes.rationale: Iteration order was made sorted because set iteration made the surviving node of a collision depend on CPython's per-process string-hash seed, breaking the cluster→relabel workflow.

nodes.label: to_json()
nodes.rationale: The anti-shrink guard fails safe: an unreadable non-empty graph.json refuses overwrite rather than silently clobbering a good graph.

nodes.label: Semantic (LLM) extraction cache
nodes.rationale: Stays unversioned so releases never re-bill LLM extraction; checkpointed per chunk so an interrupted run resumes, and zero-node results are not cached so a rerun self-heals.

nodes.label: Hyperedge handling in build/update
nodes.rationale: Eviction is scoped to genuinely deleted sources because the AST pass never re-emits hyperedges, so a broader eviction permanently lost doc-sourced semantic hyperedges.

nodes.label: graphify reflect / work-memory overlay
nodes.rationale: Implemented as a .graphify_learning.json sidecar rather than stamping graph.json so structural truth stays separate — no learning_* in exports and no rebuild churn; letting verdicts influence traversal is deferred to avoid a self-reinforcing feedback loop.

nodes.label: _score_nodes()
nodes.rationale: Per-term exact/prefix tiers are scaled by squared term coverage so a lone generic term cannot hijack seed selection in a multi-term query.

nodes.label: _pick_seeds()
nodes.rationale: Seeds the best match for each distinct query term so one term's incidental exact-match collision can't starve out the other terms' BFS neighborhoods.

nodes.label: _parse_llm_json()
nodes.rationale: Sanitizing at the single parse chokepoint protects the cache writer, the adaptive-retry merge, and the CLI merge in one place.

nodes.label: _parse_label_response()
nodes.rationale: Salvages complete id/name pairs from a reply that failed strict json.loads so a truncated response doesn't discard the whole labeling batch.

nodes.label: _call_claude_cli() / claude-cli backend
nodes.rationale: Claude Code >= ~2.1 still layers in local agent context and ignores a replacement --system-prompt, so the schema plus an explicit imperative now ride in the user turn to stop infinite chunk bisection.

nodes.label: extract_corpus_parallel()
nodes.rationale: Chunks merge in deterministic submission order after the pool drains so completion-order churn doesn't reorder graph.json between identical runs.

nodes.label: Ollama backend
nodes.rationale: Defaults to zero client-side retries because a stalled local model will not un-stall on retry, so retries only multiply the hang.

nodes.label: _resolve_csharp_type_references()
nodes.rationale: Ambiguous same-named types across namespaces are refused rather than guessed, disambiguating via the referencing file's using directives and enclosing namespace.

nodes.label: _resolve_typescript_member_calls()
nodes.rationale: Builtin-global receiver types are skipped because matching them by casefolded label bound calls to same-named user symbols, inventing phantom references and a false god node.

nodes.label: resolve_ruby_member_calls()
nodes.rationale: Resolves by inferred receiver type instead of globally-unique method name, a deliberate precision-over-recall choice: an unprovable receiver type yields no edge rather than a guess.

nodes.label: graphify/pascal_resolution.py
nodes.rationale: Corpus-wide resolver added to link a descendant's call to a base-class method declared in a different file — the common generated-base/manual-descendant split.

nodes.label: Java member-call receiver-type resolution
nodes.rationale: A missing, ambiguous, inherited, or chained receiver is skipped rather than guessed; fully-qualified and nested-type receivers are deferred because they need package/nesting-aware type identity.

nodes.label: C# receiver-typed member-call resolution
nodes.rationale: Precision over recall matching the Swift/C++/Python resolvers: an untypable receiver or a method absent on the type produces no edge, because bare-name matching mis-bound calls to unrelated same-named methods.

nodes.label: C++/Objective-C cross-file member-call resolution
nodes.rationale: Resolution is by receiver type, never bare name, grounded in how compiler-free indexers like ctags/Doxygen mis-resolve by name; the decl/def merge is gated to same-directory same-name so unrelated classes never merge.

nodes.label: Swift member-call resolution
nodes.rationale: Type-qualified static calls are EXTRACTED because the receiver type is named explicitly in source, while instance calls typed via local inference stay INFERRED.

nodes.label: json_config extractor
nodes.rationale: Creates the referenced target as a concept node before adding the edge, because edges to never-created node IDs were silently dropped by build_from_json.

nodes.label: introspect_postgres() / --postgres
nodes.rationale: Reads world-readable pg_catalog.pg_constraint keyed by oid instead of the privilege-filtered information_schema.referential_constraints, so read-only roles still get FK edges and same-named constraints don't cross-match.

nodes.label: extract_js (JS/TS extractor)
nodes.rationale: Runs the same rationale/citation post-pass as Python, closing the code-to-design-doc gap in mixed corpora at zero LLM cost (a pure line scan).

nodes.label: graphify hook-guard subcommand
nodes.rationale: Detection logic moved out of inline POSIX bash into a shell-agnostic subcommand because cmd.exe/PowerShell cannot parse the bash form, so the nudge hook failed silently on Windows.

nodes.label: Skill-version mismatch warning
nodes.rationale: Made direction-aware because install writes the package's bundled skill, so advising install on a newer on-disk skill silently downgraded it.

nodes.label: MCP server multi-project support
nodes.rationale: An optional per-tool project_path keeps the change backward-compatible and additive: a missing or corrupt project graph is a tool error, not a process exit.

nodes.label: to_obsidian() / --obsidian export
nodes.rationale: Records the files it owns in a manifest and refuses to overwrite pre-existing files it didn't create, because pointing at an existing vault silently clobbered user notes and .obsidian config.

nodes.label: normalize_id()
nodes.rationale: Colliders are salted with a short stable path hash so separator-vs-punctuation twins stay distinct while non-colliding IDs stay byte-identical (no re-migration).

nodes.label: _semantic_id_remap()
nodes.rationale: Skips a node whose source_file equals the scan root because it has no per-file identity to remap.

nodes.label: origin_file disambiguator
nodes.rationale: Kept internal and dropped before serialization because it shipped as an absolute machine-specific path, breaking output portability; source_file stays empty so a real definition can still be rewired on.

nodes.label: find_import_cycles()
nodes.rationale: Deferred dynamic imports are excluded because they are real dependencies but not static ones, so counting them manufactured phantom circular dependencies.

nodes.label: _replace_or_append_section()
nodes.rationale: Matches the section heading exactly instead of by substring, because substring matching found the wrong offset and could truncate CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Windows long-path change-detection I/O
nodes.rationale: Long absolute paths are prefixed with the extended-length marker on win32 so deeply-nested files hash and stop being re-flagged as changed every run.

nodes.label: Word-count / stat-index cache
nodes.rationale: Counts are memoized against each file's stat signature so incremental detection drops from O(corpus) parsing to O(changed); the cache root is threaded so artifacts honor --out instead of landing in the scanned corpus.

nodes.label: convert_office_file()
nodes.rationale: Re-converts the sidecar when the source is newer so an edited .docx/.xlsx re-enters --update, while an unchanged source still skips the rewrite so it never churns.

nodes.label: graphify extract --code-only
nodes.rationale: Lets a mixed repo index code via local AST without an API key instead of hard-failing when no LLM backend is configured.

nodes.label: Deterministic hub community labels
nodes.rationale: Naming each community after its highest-degree member (ties broken by node id for run-to-run stability) makes a no-LLM run readable at zero token cost instead of showing 'Community 70'.

nodes.label: Unclassified / no-extractor file reporting
nodes.rationale: Files that graphify sees but cannot parse previously left no trace at all; surfacing them grouped by extension (and naming the extra that restores a language) makes silent corpus loss visible.
